newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Armstrong active on buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong active on buy recommendation.

text.p: Shares in precision engineering specialist Armstrong Industrial Corp Ltd led the actives list in the Singapore stock exchange on Wednesday following a recommendation by a research house to accumulate the shares.
At 0430 GMT, the stock was up Singapore $0.045 to S$0.585 on 7.9 million shares.
DBS Investment Research is recommending investors "accumulate" the shares at current levels, dealers said.
The company was expected to post better earnings in 1998 when all its investments, plant capacity expansions and regionalisation plans would make an impact, dealers said.
Other broking houses such as Fraser Securities, had also recommended a buy on the stock, the dealers said.
